title: Triple index and selection are inverse
statement: For every finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, source tape $i$, and component $r\in\{0,1,2\}$ corresponding respectively to the data, visited-mark, or origin-mark bank, selecting at the physical index assigned to component $r$ of tape $i$ returns $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$i$ is a source work tape of $M$
replaced:
For every source tape $i$ and component $r$ among data, visited marks, and origin marks,
selecting at the physical index of component $r$ of bank $i$ returns exactly $r$.
